model_family: Trackastra-style compact point-context transformer, 6bba association branch

literature_evidence.citation: Gallusser B, Weigert M. Trackastra: Transformer-based cell tracking for live-cell microscopy. ECCV 2024.
literature_evidence.reported_result: Temporal all-detection attention and parental softmax improved association decisions under competition.
literature_evidence.task_relevance: The repository's pairwise gates expose correct 6bba alternatives but fail to rank and abstain consistently. Full-transition context plus an explicit no-parent alternative directly targets that measured mechanism.

hypothesis.observed_failure_mode: The all-family pilot missed its global precision gate, but its untouched fit-validation12 6bba slice reached 182 correct versus 2 harmful accepted proposals and gained 34 conservative utility over pair-NCC.
hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Restrict the compact point-context transformer to 6bba, preserve all full-pool proposal identities, and select each threshold on a video-disjoint calibration fold.
hypothesis.falsification_test: Across five nested grouped partitions of the sealed 69-video 6bba fit-train105 scope, require at least 25 held labeled proposals at precision >=0.95, then require exact held graphs to beat APNCC by >=0.005 adjusted edge Jaccard with nonnegative raw edge Jaccard and recall deltas.

early_stop_conditions: Stop on any memory, free-memory, or swap guard violation.
Stop before graph reconstruction if the aggregate held proposal prerequisite fails.
Stop without validation12 or CV57 if the exact held graph gate fails.
Stop if the guarded run cannot finish inside seven hours.
success_criteria: Every video is used as held graph evidence exactly once.
Model fitting, threshold calibration, and held graph identities are mutually disjoint within every outer fold.
Aggregate held labeled precision is at least 0.95 with at least 25 accepted proposals.
Full-pool held graphs improve adjusted edge Jaccard by at least 0.005 with nonnegative raw edge Jaccard and recall deltas.
Candidate and APNCC fragments are observation-distinct.

decision_basis: Coordinator gate review: a primary-source mechanism, strong repository-measured 6bba-only pilot signal, a sealed nested fit-only design, full-pool deployment replay, and a material exact-graph falsification threshold satisfy the local compute policy. PASS authorizes only guarded CPU fit-only work; validation12, CV57, Kaggle, GPU, and RunPod remain closed.
